events.title: Partial solar eclipse visible from Nice
events.description: Nice will see a deep partial phase of the global 12 August total solar eclipse. It starts at 19:31 CEST; the 95.1% maximum is at 20:24, with the Sun below 2° above the horizon. An unobstructed western seaward or flat horizon is essential. Direct solar viewing requires eclipse glasses meeting ISO 12312-2.

language.notes: The cited French astronomy material provides the local circumstances and viewing guidance.

pricing.notes: This is a self-guided sky phenomenon; no organised admission is stated.

reasons: Rare deep partial solar eclipse with published local circumstances

sources.name: Association Française d’Astronomie — Éclipse Info: circumstances for Nice
IMCCE — 2026 solar eclipse visibility in metropolitan France
